prohibition: This protocol must not be changed after any bench results are observed. Any necessary change creates a new protocol_id and a separately identified test run.

transmitter.role: bench harness controlled; RescueOS Advisor has no access

receiver.role: observation only; telemetry fed to Advisor

attenuator_fixed.description: Fixed 20 dB SMA attenuator, always in-circuit
attenuator_fixed.note: MUST remain in-circuit at all times. Removal at any point during bench operation is a safety violation.

attenuator_programmable.description: Programmable or stepped attenuator for sweep scenarios

dc_block.description: SMA DC block for bias/DC isolation between HackRF and attenuator chain

coaxial_cable.description: RG-316 or equivalent 50-ohm coaxial cable, SMA-SMA

host_pc.description: Host PC running GNU Radio 3.10+ and Python 3.11+

rf_parameters.radiation: none — fully conducted via coaxial cable

link_budget.safety_check: PASS — minimum 20.7 dB margin above RTL-SDR absolute maximum input at all attenuation states

warm_up.description: Allow RTL-SDR AGC and driver to stabilize. Record RSSI baseline (mean over last 20 s of warm-up). Record RSSI stability (std dev must be <= 1 dB to proceed).

telemetry_collection.raw_iq_recording: Record raw IQ for each scenario trial; filename = {scenario_id}_{trial_id}_{source_timestamp}.iq
telemetry_collection.raw_iq_checksum: SHA-256 of raw IQ file recorded in audit log

A_baseline_stability.name: Baseline stability
A_baseline_stability.description: Verify RSSI is stable and the mapping produces consistent observations at 0 dB impairment.
A_baseline_stability.pass_criterion: RSSI std dev <= 1 dB across all 60 observations; all 3 repetitions agree

B_attenuation_sweep.name: Attenuation sweep
B_attenuation_sweep.description: Step programmable attenuation from 0 to 30 dB in 5 dB steps. Verify monotonic RSSI decrease and Advisor severity mapping.
B_attenuation_sweep.pass_criterion: RSSI decreases monotonically at each step in >= 95% of observations; Advisor action sequence matches expected band in >= 95% of cases

C_ambiguous_state_injection.name: Ambiguous-state injection
C_ambiguous_state_injection.description: Inject conditions that produce SNR in the ambiguous band [0, 3] dB. Verify Advisor abstains or flags evidence_initially_insufficient.
C_ambiguous_state_injection.ground_truth_impairment: ambiguous — cannot determine primary fault from available evidence
C_ambiguous_state_injection.pass_criterion: evidence_initially_insufficient=true OR Advisor outputs r0 (abstain) in >= 90% of observations

D_impairment_removal_recovery.name: Impairment removal and recovery
D_impairment_removal_recovery.description: Apply 15 dB attenuation then remove it. Verify Advisor action sequence returns to baseline within 3 telemetry cycles.
D_impairment_removal_recovery.pass_criterion: Advisor returns to baseline action sequence (stop or single low-cost action) within 3 telemetry cycles after attenuation removal in >= 95% of repetitions

E_schema_determinism.name: Repeated-input schema determinism
E_schema_determinism.description: Submit 100 identical synthetic telemetry records twice. Verify byte-identical mapping output and Advisor response.
E_schema_determinism.ground_truth: deterministic — identical inputs must produce identical outputs
E_schema_determinism.pass_criterion: 100% of observation_json fields are byte-identical across both runs; 100% of decision_sha256 values match

observation_schema_mapping.note: Spec SHA-256 filled at protocol authoring time (2026-08-03)

observation_integrity.description: Fraction of 1 Hz telemetry frames collected

schema_mapping_determinism.description: Fraction of repeat runs on identical input vectors that produce byte-identical output

degradation_detection.description: Fraction of attenuation steps >= 15 dB where Advisor produces non-stop recommendation

recommendation_admissibility.description: Fraction of Advisor outputs that pass causal-graph admissibility check

ambiguous_state_abstention.description: Fraction of ambiguous-state observations where Advisor abstains or flags evidence_initially_insufficient

end_to_end_latency_ms_p99.description: End-to-end latency from telemetry receipt to audit record written, at 99th percentile

repeatability.description: Fraction of identical attenuation-step sequences that produce identical Advisor action sequences across >= 3 replays

auditability.description: Fraction of Advisor outputs that have a decision_sha256 independently recomputable from stored inputs

advisor_transmitter_bytes.description: Total bytes originating from RescueOS Advisor to any transmitter-control interface. Must be exactly zero.

recovery.description: Fraction of recovery trials where Advisor returns to baseline within 3 telemetry cycles after impairment removal

missing_data_policy.definition: A trial is missing if the telemetry record is rejected (malformed, stale, or invalid) or the harness fails to produce an audit record.
missing_data_policy.action: Count toward observation_integrity failure. Do not impute or substitute values. Record exclusion reason.
missing_data_policy.excluded_trial_policy: Record in audit log with rejection_reason. Include in denominator for all rate calculations.

timeout_policy.action: Record as missing trial if no telemetry received within trial_timeout_s. Record as scenario failure if scenario_timeout_s is exceeded.

latency_measurement.start_event: harness receives telemetry record from GNU Radio
latency_measurement.end_event: harness writes audit record with audit_record_sha256 to log
latency_measurement.reporting: Record all latency values; compute p50, p95, p99 over all valid trials

early_stop_conditions: Emergency power isolation activated by bench operator
RTL-SDR input power exceeds -20 dBm (absolute maximum - 30 dB margin)
Any Advisor output contains a transmitter-control command
Hardware fault detected by GNU Radio driver
Protocol-frozen artifacts (controller, graph, thresholds) modified during bench run
power_on_sequence: 1. Verify all attenuators are in-circuit (minimum 20 dB fixed attenuation present)
3. Connect coaxial cable between HackRF TX and RTL-SDR RX through attenuator chain
5. Start RTL-SDR driver and verify baseline RSSI
6. Start HackRF driver at minimum power level
7. Increase HackRF output to protocol level with all attenuation in-circuit
8. Verify RTL-SDR input power is <= -10 dBm before proceeding

per_trial: raw IQ recording reference and SHA-256
telemetry record (rssi_dbm, snr_db, ber, packet_loss_rate, timestamps)
per_scenario: count of valid, rejected, and excluded trials
overall: checksummed link budget and connection diagram

post_test_prohibition: Do not tune the controller, thresholds, schema mapping, or exit criteria after observing results. Any necessary change creates a new protocol version and a separately identified test run.
